description: Turn the cart, address and promo into a draft order and return {checkout_url, draft_id, expires_at}. Send checkout_url to the human: checkout opens pre-filled and they review and pay themselves — the agent never pays. Call it only after showing get_order_preview and getting the human's OK. Each call creates a NEW draft with its own number, so call it once per purchase; the cart itself is not emptied. The draft expires after 48 hours. Prices are re-checked; an empty cart, a missing address or no orderable items return an error (with issues) and create nothing.
name: prepare_order

checkout_url.description: Pre-filled checkout link — send it to the human to review and pay.

error.description: Empty cart, missing address or no orderable items.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 time when the draft expires (48 h).

title: Prepare checkout
